suggestions.required_finding: A support agent confirms that the broadband link is connected but the configured DNS resolver fails domain-name lookups.
suggestions.proposed_action: Restore the validated DNS resolver configuration on the broadband router, then verify domain-name resolution and website access.
suggestions.restriction: Do not factory-reset the router, change billing settings or claim a repair before DNS lookup verification succeeds.

suggestions.required_finding: Port diagnostics confirm a physical port fault; service and other ports are healthy.
suggestions.proposed_action: Use a working port temporarily and arrange a supported repair or replacement.
suggestions.restriction: Do not reset all service settings for an isolated confirmed port fault.

suggestions.required_finding: Authorized hardware check identifies a failed approved power adapter.
suggestions.proposed_action: Replace with the approved adapter matching the device requirements.
suggestions.restriction: Do not open a mains adapter or use an arbitrary substitute.
